newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends up in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends up in range trading.

text.p: The Philippine peso ended higher in range trading as banks marked time waiting for the Central Bank's next move, traders said.
The peso finished at 26.333 from 26.336, as it traded from 26.335/26.331. Volume thinned to $118.90 million from $190.20 million.
"There was not much action because the Central Bank did not cut its interest rate," a foreign bank dealer said.
However, the market was cautious. "Banks are picking up from the low. No one wants to be short of dollars," the dealer said.
Traders said there is still a possibility the Central Bank may drop rates following its surprise 0.25 percentage-point cut in its overnight borrowing rate to 10.0 percent.
Others, however, believe the Central Bank may not do so since this will impact on the peso.
"It's all up to the Central Bank," another trader said.
